body:
Build brief. Game rules approved by Karolis 30 Oct. Read each rule entry before building.
NIGHT SKIP (#rules, rules-night-skip):
- Skips to 7:00 when every player online is in their own bed. Alone: your bed is enough.
- A visiting friend counts only once in their own bed.
- Not everyone in bed: night goes on as today (5 real minutes).
- Skip saved online once, so all clocks jump together.
- Old game versions update themselves first, at the next calm moment.
- 'Pets sleep too' comes with stage 2 (rules-mech-sleep).
Also in stage 1: morning bus home (economy-morning-bus-home): every day the bus waits at the beach 8:00-9:30 and goes to town; fare 20, free under 20 coins; nothing new saved. Hats-in-hair fix on all hats and cosmetics.
ECONOMY REBALANCE: already BUILT as a patch (book db collection 'kits', doc 'economy-rebalance'; same text in project doc claude/economy-rebalance-kit.md; 2 commits on main a47bb1a, COZY_BUILD 2026103101). Covers eco-rt-01..05, 07, 08, 09 and the designer XP bug (eco-rt-10). Apply it, then build the rest on top. Kit note: quick kit line N8 fails on today's main too (fixture save-prepet1-designer2.json missing from the kit): fix the kit, never weaken the line.

comments.text: Plan: approved bus numbers added (8:00-9:30). Still approved.
